purpose: Replace only cluttered action illustrations with one large focal subject; retain the existing soft dimensional Dreams style and all asset IDs.
style: Original soft dimensional cartoon objects, confident dark blue contours, gentle bevels and soft shading, Dreams jewel blue and warm gold with small coral/green accents. Transparent background. No scenery, lettering, logos, decorative props, borders or labels. One large central subject per cell. Paired hands, rings or cups are a single unified action symbol.
